name: Félix Tshisekedi
quote: Tshisekedi pledged "deep gratitude and clear hope" for the region's future at the Dec 4, 2025 Washington Accords signing ceremony, committing to honor the agreement's terms.

name: Judith Suminwa Tuluka
quote: Told parliament on Feb 24, 2025 that more than 7,000 people had been killed in fighting in eastern DRC since the start of the year.

name: Thérèse Kayikwamba Wagner
quote: Led DRC's foreign-ministry delegation through the Washington Accords and Doha framework negotiating tracks across 2025.

name: Patrick Muyaya
role: Minister of Communication and Media / Government Spokesperson, DRC
quote: Serves as the Tshisekedi government's principal public voice on the conflict, ceasefire negotiations and peace-process developments.

name: Corneille Nangaa
quote: "We will even continue our advance towards Kinshasa until the Tshisekedi government resolves our problems." On his own role forming the M23-led coalition: "If I created the monster, I think it belongs to me to undo it."

name: Bertrand Bisimwa
quote: "We are waging an existential war because the Congolese government is subjecting part of its population to death."

name: Willy Ngoma
quote: A veteran M23 member who served as the group's public military voice until he was killed in a FARDC drone strike near Rubaya during the Feb 2026 Masisi counteroffensive.

name: Seka Musa Baluku
role: Leader, ADF / Islamic State Central Africa Province (ISCAP)
quote: Leads the ADF faction that pledged bay'ah to the Islamic State in 2019 and has since carried out attacks on civilian and Christian targets in Ituri and North Kivu under the ISCAP banner.

name: Paul Kagame
quote: "We have seen countless mediations and efforts, but none has succeeded in resolving the underlying issues. President Trump introduced a new and effective dynamism that created the space for breakthroughs... We have the clearest and most viable path forward that we have ever had."

name: Olivier Nduhungirehe
quote: Signed the Washington Accords on behalf of Rwanda's foreign ministry track alongside DRC counterparts on Jun 27, 2025.

name: Gen. James Kabarebe
role: Senior Defense and Security Adviser to the President, Rwanda
quote: Sanctioned by the US Treasury in Feb 2025 over Rwanda's support for M23 operations in eastern DRC.

name: Gen. Vincent Karusisi
quote: Sanctioned by the EU in Mar 2025 for his role in supporting abuses linked to the conflict in eastern DRC.

name: António Guterres
quote: The UN Secretariat has repeatedly urged all parties to respect ceasefire commitments while warning that MONUSCO's mandate renewal must be matched by a gradual, conditions-based drawdown.

name: Bintou Keita
role: Special Representative of the UN Secretary-General for the DRC / MONUSCO Chief
quote: Has repeatedly briefed the Security Council urging the parties to "stay the course towards durable peace," warning that violence continues in the east despite the ceasefire accord.

name: UN Group of Experts on the DRC
quote: Documented in its Jul 2025 report that Rwanda supported M23 militarily and smuggled Congolese coltan at "unprecedented levels."

name: Massad Boulos
quote: Led the Trump administration's shuttle diplomacy that laid the groundwork for both the Washington Accords and the December 2025 US-DRC minerals partnership.

name: Marco Rubio
quote: Hosted the Dec 4, 2025 Washington Accords signing ceremony on behalf of the US government, with the bilateral instruments signed under his auspices.

name: Donald Trump
quote: Witnessed the formal Dec 4, 2025 signing of the Washington Accords by Presidents Kagame and Tshisekedi at the White House, after his administration made the DRC-Rwanda conflict its first African peace initiative.

name: João Lourenço
quote: Proposed a Feb 2026 ceasefire as a follow-on to his earlier role as African Union mediator, though the initiative collapsed within days after M23 said it had not been properly consulted.

name: Government of Qatar (Doha Mediation Team)
quote: Hosted and brokered the Jul 2025 Declaration of Principles and the Nov 2025 Doha Framework for Comprehensive Peace between the DRC government and AFC/M23.

name: Martin Fayulu
quote: Leading figure of the Coalition Article 64, which announced a nationwide march for Sept 15, 2026 opposing Tshisekedi's constitutional referendum push, which the coalition says is a maneuver to enable a third presidential term.
